name: mpmb-copilot
description: Tooling and quality gates for the MPMB-Copilot monorepo

scripts.setup:all: npm run setup && npm run setup:docker && npm run setup:index
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,magenta "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.dev:backend: node ./scripts/check-port.mjs 8000 backend && uv --cache-dir .uv-cache run --no-sync --project backend uvicorn app.main:app --app-dir backend --reload --reload-dir backend/app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
scripts.lint: npm run lint:js && npm run lint:ts && npm run lint:py && npm run lint:md
scripts.lint:py: uv --cache-dir .uv-cache run --no-sync --project backend --group dev ruff check backend/app backend/tests tests scripts
scripts.lint:py:fix: uv --cache-dir .uv-cache run --no-sync --project backend --group dev ruff check backend/app backend/tests tests scripts --fix
scripts.format: npm run lint:js:fix && npm run lint:ts:fix && npm run lint:py:fix && npm run format:js && npm run format:py
scripts.format:py: uv --cache-dir .uv-cache run --no-sync --project backend --group dev ruff format backend/app backend/tests tests scripts
scripts.format:check: npm run format:check:js && npm run format:check:py
scripts.format:check:py: uv --cache-dir .uv-cache run --no-sync --project backend --group dev ruff format backend/app backend/tests tests scripts --check
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:py && npm run typecheck:ts
scripts.typecheck:py: uv --cache-dir .uv-cache run --no-sync --project backend --group dev mypy backend/app
scripts.test: uv --cache-dir .uv-cache run --no-sync --project backend --group dev pytest backend/ -v
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run test
scripts.check:full: npm run check && npm run typecheck

*.py: uv --cache-dir .uv-cache run --no-sync --project backend --group dev ruff check --fix
uv --cache-dir .uv-cache run --no-sync --project backend --group dev ruff format
